question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
WITH monthly_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        im.month_year,
        im.interest_id,
        im.composition / im.index_value AS avg_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IN ('09-2018','10-2018','11-2018','12-2018','01-2019','02-2019','03-2019','04-2019','05-2019','06-2019','07-2019','08-2019')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_year ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) AS rn
    FROM monthly_avg
),
top_monthly AS (
    SELECT r.month_year, r.interest_id, r.avg_composition AS max_index_composition
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn = 1
),
with_order AS (
    SELECT 
        tm.month_year,
        tm.interest_id,
        tm.max_index_composition,
        MAKE_DATE(TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(tm.month_year, '-', 2) AS INTEGER), 
                  TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(tm.month_year, '-', 1) AS INTEGER), 1) AS sort_dt
    FROM top_monthly tm
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        wo.month_year,
        wo.interest_id,
        wo.max_index_composition,
        AVG(wo.max_index_composition) OVER (ORDER BY wo.sort_dt ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_3m,
        LAG(wo.interest_id, 1) OVER (ORDER BY wo.sort_dt) AS prev_interest_id,
        LAG(wo.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY wo.sort_dt) AS prev_max_composition,
        LAG(wo.interest_id, 2) OVER (ORDER BY wo.sort_dt) AS prev2_interest_id,
        LAG(wo.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY wo.sort_dt) AS prev2_max_composition
    FROM with_order wo
)
SELECT 
    o.month_year AS date,
    im1.interest_name,
    o.max_index_composition,
    o.rolling_avg_3m,
    im2.interest_name AS prev_month_interest,
    o.prev_max_composition,
    im3.interest_name AS prev2_month_interest,
    o.prev2_max_composition
FROM ordered o
LEFT JOIN interest_map im1 ON im1.id = o.interest_id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im2 ON im2.id = o.prev_interest_id
LEFT JOIN interest_map im3 ON im3.id = o.prev2_interest_id
ORDER BY MAKE_DATE(TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.month_year, '-', 2) AS INTEGER), 
                  TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(o.month_year, '-', 1) AS INTEGER), 1)
